VERSION 3.28.0.172
; ONE-SHOT batch rename (not part of the normal install: lives in tools/).
; Reads /home/root/.config/qmarkable/rename.json ([{id, from, to}]) and renames
; each entry through LibraryController.setVisibleName — the same call the stock
; Rename dialog uses — so cloud sync treats it as a normal rename.
; An entry is only renamed if its current name equals "from". Results go to
; rename.log; rename.done prevents a second run. Remove this file afterwards.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    TRAVERSE Background#root > FocusScope#rootItem > FocusScope#viewRoot
        LOCATE BEFORE Item#connectivityNotifierContainer
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: qmRename
                visible: false
                readonly property string base: "file:///home/root/.config/qmarkable/"
                property int tries: 0

                function readFile(url) {
                    try {
                        var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
                        x.open("GET", url, false);
                        x.send();
                        return x.responseText || "";
                    } catch (e) {
                        return "";
                    }
                }
                function writeFile(url, text) {
                    var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    x.open("PUT", url);
                    x.send(text);
                }
                function run() {
                    if (readFile(base + "rename.done") !== "") return;
                    var text = readFile(base + "rename.json");
                    if (text === "") return;
                    var list;
                    try { list = JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) { writeFile(base + "rename.log", "bad json: " + e + "\n"); return; }
                    var log = [];
                    var ok = 0, skipped = 0, already = 0;
                    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
                        var it = list[i];
                        var entry = Library.entryForId(it.id);
                        if (!entry) { log.push("MISSING   " + it.id + "  " + it.from); skipped++; continue; }
                        var cur = "" + entry.visibleName;
                        if (cur === it.to) { log.push("ALREADY   " + it.to); already++; continue; }
                        if (cur.trim() !== it.from.trim()) { log.push("MISMATCH  " + it.id + "  now [" + cur + "] expected [" + it.from + "]"); skipped++; continue; }
                        LibraryController.setVisibleName(entry.id, it.to);
                        log.push("OK        [" + cur + "] -> [" + it.to + "]");
                        ok++;
                    }
                    log.push("done: " + ok + " renamed, " + already + " already done, " + skipped + " skipped");
                    writeFile(base + "rename.log", log.join("\n") + "\n");
                    writeFile(base + "rename.done", new Date().toISOString() + "\n");
                    console.log("[qmarkable] rename: " + ok + " renamed, " + already + " already, " + skipped + " skipped");
                }

                // wait until the library has loaded
                Timer {
                    interval: 2000
                    repeat: true
                    running: true
                    onTriggered: {
                        qmRename.tries++;
                        if (Library.isReady || qmRename.tries > 30) {
                            running = false;
                            qmRename.run();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
